raw_segments.text: Beatrice, what should I do with him? Dress him in my apparel and make him my waiting
gentlewoman. He that hath a beard is more than a youth, and he that hath no beard is
less than a man. And he that is more than a youth is not for me. And he that is less
than a man, I am not for him. Therefore I will even take six pence in earnest of the
airward and lead his apes into hell.
